data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this exceptional 4-bedroom townhouse for rent in District One Phase III, Mohammed Bin Rashid City.

Offering a spacious built-up area of 3,142.95 sq. ft., this brand-new G+2 townhouse is one of only 12 exclusive residences of its kind. Designed with contemporary architecture and premium finishes, it delivers an exceptional lifestyle with breathtaking lagoon views, generous living spaces, and outstanding privacy.

The home features a private elevator connecting all floors, a fully equipped Miele kitchen, spacious terraces and balconies, and a maid's room, making it ideal for families seeking luxury and convenience in one of Dubai's most prestigious communities.
